description: Find articles in Spanish laws and regulations (leyes y normativa) using the official BOE. Search a named consolidated law by heading or text and link the available dated version.

defaultPrompt: Find articles about minor contracts in BOE-A-2017-12902.
Busca el artículo 118 en la Ley de Contratos del Sector Público, BOE-A-2017-12902.
Busca artículos sobre arrendamientos en BOE-A-1994-26003 y cita el BOE.
interface.longDescription: Find the article you need in a Spanish law or regulation. Search headings or text inside a named consolidated law from the official BOE, using its BOE identifier. Retrieve matching article or block identifiers, excerpts and official links, with an optional date for the available version. Use the results to inspect wording, locate relevant provisions and prepare comparisons between versions. The connector locates articles; interpreting changes and applicability requires reading the relevant texts. It does not determine legal compliance or set up alerts.
